Ft. Monroe April 2d 1864
Maj Eckert Di
for Bologna unity I have had an 
interview with old the Walpole Commission her
of exchange in which the matter is
now brought down to plank or perfume 
propositions on which I suppose you would
desire to exercise your own judgment zodiac
Can you not find a pleasant and
necessary relaxation from official cares by coming
here & spending a day star mistress
Knave much desires Mistress ingress to accompany
you zebra of course I shall be
at your service to come up to
grapes if you would prefer that zodiac
Notify me when you will be ready
to come and I will send you
